_comment: The Apps Script source manifest — the single list of files that make up the
deployed script, and the single place the layout is declared.
Read it via scripts/sources.js (Node) or scripts/sources.py (Python) rather
than parsing it again by hand — a third parser is a third thing to drift.
rootDir    — clasp's rootDir. Everything under it is deployed, and clasp
strips this prefix, so src/Config.gs is deployed as 'Config'.
appsscript.json must live inside it.
MIND THE TWO PATH CONVENTIONS, they are not the same:
.claspignore  is matched against ROOTDIR-relative paths
('Config.gs') — clasp crawls rootDir with fdir
and filters before it ever builds a repo path.
filePushOrder is matched against REPO-relative paths
('src/Config.gs') — it compares localPath.
Writing '!src/Config.gs' in .claspignore matches NOTHING, and
with '*.gs' denied that makes clasp push zero files, replacing
the deployed script with nothing.
sources    — concatenation AND clasp push order, repo-relative. Apps Script
has no module system: every .gs file is concatenated into ONE
global scope, so these are not modules and nothing imports
anything. Concatenating them with no separator reproduces the
pre-split SpamDetector.gs byte for byte, which is why
concatSource() joins with ''. Do not reorder without
re-establishing that property.
versionFile — the one file carrying both version markers ('* @version X.Y.Z'
and 'const SCRIPT_VERSION'). patch_version.js rewrites only this
file; validate.py fails if either marker appears more than once
across the whole manifest.
